startup.version: The bundled converter doesn't match this app
row.label: {file}, {status}
startup.protocolBody: The app and its converter speak different versions of their protocol (the app expects {app}, the converter answered {engine}). Converting now could produce wrong results, so nothing will run.
startup.irBody: The app and its converter use different versions of the document format (the app reads {app}, the converter writes {engine}). Converting now could produce wrong results, so nothing will run.
startup.missingBody: The converter did not start or did not answer, so nothing will run.
startup.reinstall: This usually means the installation is incomplete or was partly updated. Reinstalling OpenConvert {version} fixes it. Your EPUBs and settings are not affected.
startup.versionBody: This app is version {app}, but the converter it found is version {engine}. They are shipped together and must be the same version, so nothing will run.
startup.versionHint: An update may have been interrupted. Install OpenConvert {app} again. Your EPUBs and settings are not affected.
error.limit: This document exceeds a size limit for a single conversion.
error.limitHint: You can raise "Max pages" or "Max memory" in Settings › Advanced and convert it again.
error.unreadable: This file could not be read.
error.start: The converter could not be started for this file.
error.passwordTried: An empty password was tried first.
